documents.text: Account recovery uses the recovery page. Verify identity before changing an account email.
Refund status appears in the billing settlement record. Pending refunds include a settlement reference.
Password reset links expire after use. Request one fresh reset link and discard the old link.
Order tracking shows carrier scans. A parcel without a recent scan can receive a carrier trace.
Sign-in security codes depend on an accurate device clock. Synchronize the clock before retrying.
Invoices list service lines and totals. A duplicate service line should be sent to billing review.
Application launch failures need the app version and a sanitized launch log.
Plan comparisons describe export availability and current product limits.
